revisions.name: $win32_dispatch_inner
revisions.reason: Unsupported ordinal dispatch reads a process-lifetime copied diagnostic name from its ORD record instead of overwriting the fixed KERNEL32 buffer. It logs that name and calls the same crash_unimplemented boundary, whose unreachable still traps even when the host callback returns. No guest callback, continuation identity, stack restoration or ownership admission changes. Synthetic EXE and DLL import/dispatch regressions retain numeric ordinals, distinct DLL names, existing resolved/named execution and fail-fast behavior. General callback ownership remains pending.
